description: Search live veterinary job listings on VetJobs.au, Australia's dedicated veterinary job board: veterinarian, veterinary nurse, locum, practice manager, reception and animal care roles posted by clinics, hospitals and practices across Australia (plus some New Zealand roles), with no recruiter middlemen. Expired listings are never returned; a listing that is gone from the source disappears from results. Each listing reports provenance: source, is_imported, first_party and source_url. Pass first_party=true to restrict results to listings the employer posted directly — the most current inventory, and the subset safest to cite.

category.description: Occupation slug. Call list_categories first for the vocabulary and live counts, e.g. veterinary-nurse, veterinarian-small-animal.

employment_type.description: FULL_TIME, PART_TIME, LOCUM_TENENS, CASUAL, CONTRACTOR, TEMPORARY, RESIDENCY, INTERNSHIP, VOLUNTEER or OTHER.

first_party.description: true = only listings posted directly by the employer (excludes scraped imports); false = only imports. Omit for both.

new_graduates_accepted.description: true = only listings that say they accept new graduates (graduate-friendly roles); false = only listings that do not. Omit for both.

q.description: Free-text search over title, employer, location and description.

state.description: Australian state/territory code, e.g. QLD, NSW, VIC.

updated_since.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime. Returns only listings changed since then — use this for incremental sync instead of re-fetching everything.

name: search_jobs
title: Search Australian veterinary jobs
